verdict: Citigroup posted its best third-quarter revenue in a decade — $23.8B, up 8% — and earned $5.2B as Services grew 15%, Wealth 15% and operating costs fell 2%.

kpis.label: Credit costs
kpis.note: $2.2B of net credit losses plus a $369M reserve build

segments.name: Net interest income
segments.note: Interest earned on loans and securities, minus interest paid on deposits and borrowings — up 14% on bigger loan and deposit balances.

segments.name: Noninterest revenue
segments.note: Fees, trading and other non-interest income — down 4%, as Markets and U.S. Consumer Cards declines outweighed growth in Services, Banking, Wealth and All Other.

opex.name: Compensation & benefits
opex.note: Pay and benefits — the bank's biggest cost, up 1% YoY.

opex.name: Transactional & product servicing
opex.note: The cost of processing transactions and servicing products — up 20%.

opex.name: Premises, professional & other
opex.note: Premises and equipment $632M, professional services $434M, advertising $234M and other operating costs $1,445M.

takeaways.title: Services is the standout
takeaways.text: Services revenue rose 15% to $6.6B — Treasury and Trade Solutions up 16% and Securities Services up 13% — and the business earned $2.6B, up 27%, at a 31.2% return on tangible equity.

takeaways.title: Interest income did the heavy lifting
takeaways.text: Net interest income rose 14% to $17.0B on loan growth of 12% and deposit growth of 9%. It is now 71% of all revenue, more than covering the 4% dip in fee and trading income.

takeaways.title: EPS up 53% on an easy comparison
takeaways.text: EPS rose 53% to $2.85. Part of the jump is the comparison base: a year ago included a $726M goodwill impairment tied to the Banamex stake sale. Excluding that item, year-ago EPS was $2.24 and growth was 27%. Citi returned $4.1B to shareholders in the quarter.

oneTimers: The year-ago quarter included a $726M goodwill impairment ($714M after tax) in operating expenses, tied to the agreement to sell a 25% stake in Banamex — it flatters this quarter's reported EPS growth (53% reported vs 27% excluding the item). No comparable notable item was flagged in Q3 2026.
otherDetail: Citigroup reports no separate other income line in this presentation — everything sits in revenue, credit costs, operating expenses and tax.
footerNote: For a bank, credit costs (the provision for credit losses) play the role of cost of revenue. The flow uses income from continuing operations of $5,420M; after $175M attributable to noncontrolling interests, Citigroup's net income was $5,245M ($2.85 per diluted share). Net interest income and the expense breakdown come from the Q3 2026 financial supplement (Exhibit 99.2).
